summary: mTLS event streams behind a load balancer need SSL pass-through (L4 routing) because client cert validation happens at the platform gateway proxy. There are also specialised GitLab, GitHub, ServiceNow and Dynatrace event streams that prefill defaults on top of the basic types.
questions: Why does my mTLS event stream fail behind a load balancer?
Do I need SSL pass-through for EDA mTLS event streams?
What is the GitHub event stream type?
